verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird offers some digital legal tools, such as the SCC and Term Sheet generators, so an API spec is a conceivable ask, but nothing in the evidence shows a published OpenAPI or equivalent spec. Probes of the common OpenAPI and Swagger paths all returned 404. The tools are described only as interactive questionnaires built on third-party Contract Express.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
